summary: Implemented rich_measure on Tree and the VerticalCenter feature. Changes: rich/tree.py adds Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative, explicit stack, level counter, 4 cells per level). rich/align.py adds Align.__repr__, the Align width constraint (measured maximum, capped by explicit width), and the public VerticalCenter class with render, measurement, and repr. rich/console.py sets render-option justify to "default" in print. CHANGELOG.md marks 9.8.0 as Unreleased with an Added subheading (existing bullet kept). tests/test_align.py and tests/test_tree.py gained the specified imports and tests. Nothing was run, per instructions; all verification is by reading. Open risk: Align now constrains to width 0 for zero-width renderables such as empty strings; this is unverified and existing Align and print tests should be checked first. No commits were made.
